FROM sets AS T1
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T3 ON T1."XCL_099" = T3."XCL_093"
WHERE T3."XCL_092" = 'Chinese Simplified'

    SELECT T2."XCL_063"

    INNER JOIN legalities AS T4 ON T2."XCL_072" = T4."XCL_086"
    WHERE T4."XCL_085" = 'Banned'
